title: EvidenceSource
description: A single source within an Evidence Artifact Package. Evidence is always hostile/untrusted data (CLAUDE.md Section 15) - this type never carries executable instructions, only provenance and fetched content metadata. `sourceClass` corrected per external A0 review finding A0-004 to use the exact ADR-011 governed source classes instead of an invented descriptive taxonomy.

sourceClass.description: The exact initial governed Reclose source classes per ADR-011. This field controls per-rule source policy/trust weighting (TM-EVID-003/004) and MUST NOT be overloaded with descriptive UI categories - see `sourceType` for that.

sourceType.description: Optional descriptive/provenance-grouping metadata for UI/Judge display purposes only (PRD-REP-004). This is NOT a trust classification and has no bearing on `sourceClass`'s security semantics - it exists so the product can show 'status page' vs 'social' style categories without corrupting the governed source-class enum.
